FL-202.label: The model browser: every model the token source offers, ranked, pinnable, with price and context window; the thinking level beside it; the standard configurations one click away.
FL-202.walk: Open the model chip on a conversation: the source's models are listed ranked with price and context window; pin one and it stays on top; pick another and the thread switches to it and stays on it — new conversations start on it too, until you change it, and the chip says so; set the thinking level beside it; pick a standard configuration (pinned, max, elbow, floor) and see what it selects now; switching back from a model to a policy is one click.
FL-202.observed: The live broker catalog, prices/context, local unpriced listing, pin persistence and offline switch work. The full alternate-model/reasoning/max/elbow/floor SOP is not performed under the owner mini-only restriction; no broad model-browser acceptance is inferred.

FL-152.label: Cost routing: lowest cost above an intelligence threshold, or a spend rate per hour buying the most intelligence that burn allows.
FL-152.walk: Set Floor with an intelligence threshold in the token-cost policy; a new thread's chosen model is the cheapest one at or above that threshold. Set Budget with dollars per hour; a new thread's chosen model is the most intelligent one the agents' measured hourly token burn can buy for that, and the readout says what it costs an hour and what the next smarter model would cost.
FL-152.observed: This row became required after the peer M6CR ledger update. Its new Budget UI is on unmerged Harness PR 106, not current main or M6LM. No peer branch is integrated and no non-mini policy is used; the new budget acceptance remains context-only.

FL-153.label: The elbow: a standard point on the cost-to-intelligence Pareto curve.
FL-153.walk: Choose the elbow policy; a new thread's policy readout names which frontier model is the elbow, how far below the frontier's price chord it sits, and what the next model up adds for its price.
FL-153.observed: The peer M6CR elbow definition is pending its product PRs and owner F215 ruling. This branch retains current main policy behavior and uses pinned mini for all calls; it does not claim the new elbow readout.
